events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 715 AM CST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3
and 5 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to
2 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Benavides, Concepcion, Ramirez, Realitos, Rios and Cruz Calle.

events.summary:
At 714 AM CST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2
and 5 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5
to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Oilton, Mirando City, Bruni, Aguilares and Ranchitos Las Lomas.

This includes US Highway 59 between mile markers 790 and 816.

events.region: Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, east winds 20 to 30
kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 6 to 8 ft expected. For the
first Gale Warning, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 50
kt and seas 6 to 11 ft expected. For the second Small Craft
Advisory, northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt
and seas 18 to 23 ft expected. For the second Gale Warning,
east winds 40 to 50 kt with gusts up to 65 kt and seas 29 to
34 ft expected.

* WHERE...Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, from midnight
tonight to 3 AM AKST Monday. For the first Gale Warning, from
3 AM to 6 AM AKST Monday. For the second Small Craft Advisory,
from 6 AM to noon AKST Monday. For the second Gale Warning,
from noon to 6 PM AKST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
